This section highlights my work as I go through Hadley Wickham and Garrett Grolemun's "[R for Data Science](https://r4ds.had.co.nz/index.html "R for Data Science Textbook")". This is to demonstrate my abilities with R and also to document my improvement as I work through the book.

The page was created in RStudio using an R notebook.
